Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M Griffin was an upgraded version of the design built for House Marik by Earthwerks and Brigadier Corps starting in 3049. With production lines on Keystone and Oliver this variant sought to enhance the original's long-range capabilities. The engine was exchanged for a Hermes 275 extralight model and carried fourteen double heat sinks to improve heat management. The normal PPC was replaced by a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC, for longer reach at the expense of more heat, and the LRM launcher had been upgraded to a Doombud LRM-20 launcher, for more indirect fire support capabilities. Finally a ChrisComp Small Laser was mounted in the head and the two tons of LRM reloads in the left torso were protected by CASE. While intended for the Free Worlds League Military the capture of Oliver by FedCom forces meant the 3M also appeared in large numbers in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M狮鹫是该设计的升级版本，由地球工厂与准将军团自3049年起为马里克家族建造。该变型在基斯通与奥利弗设有生产线，意在强化原版的远程能力。引擎换成赫尔墨斯275超轻型，并带十四个双散热器以改善热量管理。标准粒子炮换成菲西贡长牙增程粒子炮，以更高热量换取更远射程；LRM发射器升级为杜姆巴德LRM-20，以增强间接火力支援能力。最后，头部装了一门ChrisComp小型激光，左躯干的两吨LRM再装填弹药由CASE保护。该型号本为自由世界联盟军队而造，但联邦共和部队夺取奥利弗后，3M也大量出现在联邦共和武装部队中。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M Griffin was an upgraded version of the design built for House Marik by Earthwerks and Brigadier Corps starting in 3049. With production lines on Keystone and Oliver this variant sought to enhance the original's long-range capabilities. The engine was exchanged for a Hermes 275 extralight model and carried fourteen double heat sinks to improve heat management. The normal PPC was replaced by a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC, for longer reach at the expense of more heat, and the LRM launcher had been upgraded to a Doombud LRM-20 launcher, for more indirect fire support capabilities. Finally a ChrisComp Small Laser was mounted in the head and the two tons of LRM reloads in the left torso were protected by CASE. While intended for the Free Worlds League Military the capture of Oliver by FedCom forces meant the 3M also appeared in large numbers in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M 狮鹫是为马里克家族打造的升级版，由地球工厂与准将兵团自 3049 年起生产。借助基斯通与奥利弗的生产线，该变体力图强化原版的远程能力。引擎换成赫尔墨斯 275 超轻型，并携带十四台双倍散热器以改善散热管理。标准 PPC 换成"富西贡长牙"ER PPC，以更多热量换取更远射程；LRM 发射器升级为末日芽 LRM-20，以增强间接火力支援能力。最后，头部安装一门克里斯康小型激光，左躯干的两吨 LRM 再装填由 C.A.S.E. 保护。虽然原为自由世界联盟军队设计，但联邦联邦部队夺取奥利弗意味着 3M 也大量出现在联邦联邦武装部队中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to it's notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1N is powered by a 330 rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 97km/h. A PPC and an SRM-6 form the Mechs weapons load. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最早量产的四肢机甲之一，55 吨的 Scorpion 于 2570 年投产，定位为步兵支援单位。由于步态出了名地不稳，大多数机甲战士都对它敬而远之，但 Scorpion 在整个继承战争及之后的岁月里始终未曾中断服役。Scorpion 1N 由 330 级聚变核心驱动，最高时速可达 97km/h。一门粒子炮和一具 SRM-6 构成了该机甲的武器配置。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.03

Shunned by most MechWarriors due to it's notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1N is powered by a 330 rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 97km/h. A PPC and an SRM-6 form the Mechs weapons load.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最早量产的四肢机甲之一，55吨的蝎式于2570年作为步兵支援单位投产。由于其步态以不稳著称，大多数机甲战士对它避而远之，但蝎式仍在整个继承战争及其后不间断地服役。蝎式1N由一台330额定聚变核心驱动，最高速度97公里/小时。武器为一门粒子炮和一具SRM-6。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The seasonal Assault 'Mech tournament is beginning to enter its twilight hours, folks! Figuratively, of course. It's still bright and sunny down on the faux streets of the arena, and it's just as well! We've got another exciting new match coming your way!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 各位，季节性突击机甲锦标赛正开始步入尾声！当然是比喻意义上的。竞技场的人造街道上依旧阳光灿烂，这样正好！又一场激动人心的新对局即将呈现在大家面前！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm still reading through the three-hundred page legal document they sent our way, but so far it all seems reasonable. As for the arena, the Tennesse Valley used to be a wildlife reserve back in the day. Expect mud, and trees.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我还在读他们发给我们的那份三百页法律文件，但到目前为止一切看起来都合理。至于竞技场，田纳西谷当年是一片野生动物保护区。预期会有泥浆和树木。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Welcome to the Solaris Seasonal Assault 'Mech Championship, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}! In case you're unfamiliar, this is a standard 64-bracket single elimination tournament. Defeat each opponent to move further up the rankings for fame, fortune, glory, and fame! Just be warned that if you lose a match, you're out. We don't faff around with losers bracket nonsense here.

For your first match, it looks like we have you penned in with some fellow newcomers in the Tennesee Valley arena. Break a leg!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
欢迎来到索拉里斯赛季突击机甲锦标赛，指挥官 {COMMANDER.LastName}！若您还不了解，这是一场标准的64人单败淘汰赛。击败每个对手，在排名中不断攀升，赢取名声、财富、荣耀与名声！但要提醒您，输掉一场比赛就出局。我们这儿可不搞败者组那套无聊把戏。

您的首场比赛，看起来我们把您和几位新秀一起安排在了田纳西谷竞技场。祝您好运！

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 各位兄弟、姐妹以及非二元的朋友们！哈雷顿·斯普林比再次带来{COMPANY.CompanyName}传奇的下一个篇章！他们从底层起步，闯过了三场残酷的比赛，赢得了在索拉里斯城的一席之地！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: From what I've heard, we're looking at a seasoned Solaris veteran, Commander. Make sure we're sending our best. We can't afford to pull punches here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据我所知，我们要面对的是一位经验丰富的索拉里斯老手，指挥官。务必派出我们最好的人。这里可不能手下留情。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 能走到这一步你干得不错，指挥官。这是崭新的一天，竞技场已准备就绪，而观众爆满！不出所料，你的对手是周围最顶尖的机师之一，驾驶着一台棘手的机甲。祝好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3M Griffin was an upgraded version of the design built for House Marik by Earthwerks and Brigadier Corps starting in 3049. With production lines on Keystone and Oliver this variant sought to enhance the original's long-range capabilities. The engine was exchanged for a Hermes 275 extralight model and carried fourteen double heat sinks to improve heat management. The normal PPC was replaced by a Fusigon Longtooth ER PPC, for longer reach at the expense of more heat, and the LRM launcher had been upgraded to a Doombud LRM-20 launcher, for more indirect fire support capabilities. Finally a ChrisComp Small Laser was mounted in the head and the two tons of LRM reloads in the left torso were protected by CASE. While intended for the Free Worlds League Military the capture of Oliver by FedCom forces meant the 3M also appeared in large numbers in the Armed Forces of the Federated Commonwealth. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3M狮鹫是该设计的升级版本，由地球工厂与准将军团自3049年起为马里克家族建造。该变型在基斯通与奥利弗设有生产线，意在强化原版的远程能力。引擎换成赫尔墨斯275超轻型，并带十四个双散热器以改善热量管理。标准粒子炮换成菲西贡长牙增程粒子炮，以更高热量换取更远射程；LRM发射器升级为杜姆巴德LRM-20，以增强间接火力支援能力。最后，头部装了一门ChrisComp小型激光，左躯干的两吨LRM再装填弹药由CASE保护。该型号本为自由世界联盟军队而造，但联邦共和部队夺取奥利弗后，3M也大量出现在联邦共和武装部队中。 特性：战拳 投放费用倍率：1.05

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to it's notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 1N is powered by a 330 rated Fusion Core giving it a top speed of 97km/h. A PPC and an SRM-6 form the Mechs weapons load. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最早量产的四肢机甲之一，55 吨的 Scorpion 于 2570 年投产，定位为步兵支援单位。由于步态出了名地不稳，大多数机甲战士都对它敬而远之，但 Scorpion 在整个继承战争及之后的岁月里始终未曾中断服役。Scorpion 1N 由 330 级聚变核心驱动，最高时速可达 97km/h。一门粒子炮和一具 SRM-6 构成了该机甲的武器配置。 特性：改进生命维持 投放费用倍率：1.03

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's affirmative. Take them down as well, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认。把他们也解决掉，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's affirmative. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} rep has offered a bonus if we eliminate them, as well. Your call, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 代表提出，如果我们把他们也消灭掉会有额外奖励。你决定，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We're on station and will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's destroyed we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们已就位，将提供支援以完成主要目标。目标被摧毁后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's it Commander we did what we came here to do.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就这样，指挥官，我们来这里要做的事做完了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's unfortunate. I'll let our employers know what happened.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真不巧。我会把情况告知我们的雇主。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 已被摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary targets are down. That's a wrap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标已倒下。收工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second enemy lance was last seen here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第二支敌方小队最后出现在这里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: we're clear of the AO, thanks Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已离开作战区域，谢谢指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You're approaching the encounter area, Commander. First enemy lance is in this area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你正在接近交战区域，指挥官。第一支敌方小队就在这一带。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recover the VIP's assistant by securing the Secondary Designated Area
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领次要指定区域以接回要人的助手

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unit Carrying the Flag Must Survive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 携带旗标的单位必须存活

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset has been recovered, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产已回收，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Best of luck, Commander. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the Flag location is straight ahead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，旗标位置就在正前方。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold this location until the Flag is captured.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守住此处直到旗标被夺取。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ladies and Gentlemen welcome to Solaris Heavy League battle! Let the fight begin!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女士们先生们，欢迎来到索拉里斯重型联赛对战！让战斗开始吧！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once you have secured the Flag, you need to get to the extraction zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夺取旗标后，你需要前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's it, mech recovering our Secondary Target is scraped. S&R will look for what's left. That objective is failed. Focus on the Primary.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 完了，回收我们次要目标的那台机甲报废了。搜救队会去找剩下能用的东西。那个目标失败了。专注主要目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Flag has been recovered, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旗标已夺回，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Flag has been recovered, Commander. Now you need to bring it to the extraction point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旗标已夺回，指挥官。现在你需要把它带到撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The mech carrying the Flag is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 携带旗标的机甲正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This went south in a hurry. Better luck next time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这事很快就搞砸了。下次好运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 4x4 Heavy Free For All Battle
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4x4 重型近战

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, in this match 3 lances drop, the one that survives - wins.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，本场比赛空降三个小队，活下来的那个获胜。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All our objectives are complete, cover our withdraw Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们所有目标都已完成，掩护我们撤退，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander! This is the Primary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander! This is the Secondary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another successful mission in the bag, Commander. Let's debrief once you're back aboard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一场成功任务入袋，指挥官。等你回到舰上我们再做简报。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} friends have deployed forces to assist in our operation here. This is the Primary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友已派出部队协助我们此处的行动。这是主要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} friends have deployed forces to assist in our operation here. This is the Secondary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友已派出部队协助我们此处的行动。这是次要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we have visuals on the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们目视到第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Copy that lance leader.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，小队长。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander. Oliviera out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。奥利维拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Got a Leopard on radar, Commander. Looks like it's making a drop; I'll mark its LZ for you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷达上有一艘"豹"级，指挥官。看来它要投放部队，我会为你标出它的着陆区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Grace under fire folks. Lay it on 'em!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 各位，火线之下也要沉住气。狠狠地打！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hark {COMMANDER.Name} here are unexpected {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} bad guys  are here too. Don't that beat it all. This is the secondary objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听好了 {COMMANDER.Name}，这里还来了意想不到的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 坏蛋。真是奇了怪了。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hark {COMMANDER.Name} here are unexpected {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} bad guys are here too. Don't that beat it all. This is the primary objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听好了 {COMMANDER.Name}，这里还来了意想不到的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 坏蛋。真是奇了怪了。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, Darius I'm seeing new heat signatures on the field. Second enemy lance is unbound?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，达里乌斯，我在战场上看到新的热信号。第二支敌方小队解除了约束？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: holy cow what a surprise its a {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance! A surprise indeed. This is the Primary Objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的天，真是惊喜，居然是一支 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！确实是惊喜。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: holy cow what a surprise its a {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance! A surprise indeed. This is the Secondary Objective version.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm inbound to the LZ, Commander. Get your people over there for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我正前往着陆区，指挥官。让你的人过去等待接运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm seeing new heat signatures on the field, Commander. Our mystery tangos, I'm guessing?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在战场上看到新的热信号，指挥官。我猜是我们的神秘目标？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ladies and Gentlemen welcome to Solaris Heavy League battle! Let the fight begin!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女士们先生们，欢迎来到索拉里斯重型联赛对战！让战斗开始吧！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we have some unexpected support from {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. This is the Primary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们有来自 {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队的意外支援。这是主要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we have some unexpected support from {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. This is the Secondary version.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on the field. This is the Primary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战场上出现更多 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on the field. This is the Secondary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战场上出现更多 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added taking this group to contract as a bonus. If we want to make some extra C-bills we can take them out if we want.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把歼灭这伙人列为合同的附加奖励。想多赚点 C 币的话，我们可以顺手干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added taking this group to contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: our employer's ally forces are lost commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们雇主的盟友部队已失联，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACEHODLER This is Quebec actual return fire and check your rear arc!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本 这里是 Quebec 实况，还击并检查你的后方射界！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Dropped Forces Enemy Ally Primary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外空降部队·敌方盟友·主要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Dropped Forces Enemy Ally Secondary) . In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外空降部队·敌方盟友·次要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Dropped Target Forces 2 Primary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外空降目标部队 2·主要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Target Forces 2 Secondary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外目标部队 2·次要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Target Forces Primary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外目标部队·主要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Target Forces Secondary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Hostile to All Secondary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（对所有人敌对·次要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's affirmative. Take them down as well, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认。把他们也解决掉，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's affirmative. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} rep has offered a bonus if we eliminate them, as well. Your call, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 代表提出，如果我们把他们也消灭掉会有额外奖励。你决定，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We're on station and will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's destroyed we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们已就位，将提供支援以完成主要目标。目标被摧毁后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's it Commander we did what we came here to do.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就这样，指挥官，我们来这里要做的事做完了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's unfortunate. I'll let our employers know what happened.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真不巧。我会把情况告知我们的雇主。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 已被摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary targets are down. That's a wrap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标已倒下。收工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second enemy lance was last seen here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第二支敌方小队最后出现在这里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: we're clear of the AO, thanks Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已离开作战区域，谢谢指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You're approaching the encounter area, Commander. First enemy lance is in this area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你正在接近交战区域，指挥官。第一支敌方小队就在这一带。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这次我们输了，下次好运，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the Flag location is straight ahead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，旗标位置就在正前方。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold this location until the Flag is captured.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守住此处直到旗标被夺取。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ladies and Gentlemen welcome to Solaris Light League battle! Let the fight begin!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女士们先生们，欢迎来到索拉里斯轻型联赛对战！让战斗开始吧！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once you have secured the Flag, you need to get to the extraction zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夺取旗标后，你需要前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's it, mech recovering our Secondary Target is scraped. S&R will look for what's left. That objective is failed. Focus on the Primary.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 完了，回收我们次要目标的那台机甲报废了。搜救队会去找剩下能用的东西。那个目标失败了。专注主要目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Flag has been recovered, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旗标已夺回，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Flag has been recovered, Commander. Now you need to bring it to the extraction point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旗标已夺回，指挥官。现在你需要把它带到撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The mech carrying the Flag is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 携带旗标的机甲正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This went south in a hurry. Better luck next time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这事很快就搞砸了。下次好运。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，本场比赛空降三个小队，活下来的那个获胜。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Player 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be the only surviving team
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 成为唯一存活的队伍

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Lance 1
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁第一小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Lance 2
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁第二小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All our objectives are complete, cover our withdraw Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们所有目标都已完成，掩护我们撤退，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander! This is the Primary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander! This is the Secondary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another successful mission in the bag, Commander. Let's debrief once you're back aboard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一场成功任务入袋，指挥官。等你回到舰上我们再做简报。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} friends have deployed forces to assist in our operation here. This is the Primary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友已派出部队协助我们此处的行动。这是主要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} friends have deployed forces to assist in our operation here. This is the Secondary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友已派出部队协助我们此处的行动。这是次要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we have visuals on the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们目视到第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Copy that lance leader.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，小队长。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander. Oliviera out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。奥利维拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Got a Leopard on radar, Commander. Looks like it's making a drop; I'll mark its LZ for you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷达上有一艘"豹"级，指挥官。看来它要投放部队，我会为你标出它的着陆区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Grace under fire folks. Lay it on 'em!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 各位，火线之下也要沉住气。狠狠地打！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hark {COMMANDER.Name} here are unexpected {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} bad guys  are here too. Don't that beat it all. This is the secondary objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听好了 {COMMANDER.Name}，这里还来了意想不到的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 坏蛋。真是奇了怪了。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hark {COMMANDER.Name} here are unexpected {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} bad guys are here too. Don't that beat it all. This is the primary objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听好了 {COMMANDER.Name}，这里还来了意想不到的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 坏蛋。真是奇了怪了。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, Darius—I'm seeing new heat signatures on the field. Second enemy lance is unbound?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，达里乌斯——我在战场上看到新的热信号。第二支敌方小队解除了约束？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: holy cow what a surprise its a {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance! A surprise indeed. This is the Primary Objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的天，真是惊喜，居然是一支 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！确实是惊喜。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: holy cow what a surprise its a {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance! A surprise indeed. This is the Secondary Objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的天，真是惊喜，居然是一支 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！确实是惊喜。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm inbound to the LZ, Commander. Get your people over there for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我正前往着陆区，指挥官。让你的人过去等待接运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm seeing new heat signatures on the field, Commander. Our mystery tangos, I'm guessing?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在战场上看到新的热信号，指挥官。我猜是我们的神秘目标？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ladies and Gentlemen welcome to Solaris Light League battle! Let the fight begin!

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就这样，指挥官，我们来这里要做的事做完了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's unfortunate. I'll let our employers know what happened.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真不巧。我会把情况告知我们的雇主。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 已被摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第二支敌方小队最后出现在这里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Copy that lance leader.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，小队长。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander. Oliviera out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。奥利维拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Got a Leopard on radar, Commander. Looks like it's making a drop; I'll mark its LZ for you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷达上有一艘"豹"级，指挥官。看来它要投放部队，我会为你标出它的着陆区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Grace under fire folks. Lay it on 'em!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 各位，火线之下也要沉住气。狠狠地打！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hark {COMMANDER.Name} here are unexpected {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} bad guys  are here too. Don't that beat it all. This is the secondary objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听好了 {COMMANDER.Name}，这里还来了意想不到的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 坏蛋。真是奇了怪了。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hark {COMMANDER.Name} here are unexpected {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} bad guys are here too. Don't that beat it all. This is the primary objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听好了 {COMMANDER.Name}，这里还来了意想不到的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 坏蛋。真是奇了怪了。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, Darius—I'm seeing new heat signatures on the field. Second enemy lance is unbound?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，达里乌斯——我在战场上看到新的热信号。第二支敌方小队解除了约束？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: holy cow what a surprise its a {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance! A surprise indeed. This is the Primary Objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的天，真是惊喜，居然是一支 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！确实是惊喜。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: holy cow what a surprise its a {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance! A surprise indeed. This is the Secondary Objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的天，真是惊喜，居然是一支 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！确实是惊喜。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm inbound to the LZ, Commander. Get your people over there for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我正前往着陆区，指挥官。让你的人过去等待接运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm seeing new heat signatures on the field, Commander. Our mystery tangos, I'm guessing?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在战场上看到新的热信号，指挥官。我猜是我们的神秘目标？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ladies and Gentlemen welcome to Solaris Light League battle! Let the fight begin!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女士们先生们，欢迎来到索拉里斯轻型联赛对战！让战斗开始吧！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we have some unexpected support from {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. This is the Primary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们有来自 {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队的意外支援。这是主要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we have some unexpected support from {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. This is the Secondary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们有来自 {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队的意外支援。这是次要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on the field. This is the Primary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战场上出现更多 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on the field. This is the Secondary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战场上出现更多 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added taking this group to contract as a bonus. If we want to make some extra C-bills we can take them out if we want.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把歼灭这伙人列为合同的附加奖励。想多赚点 C 币的话，我们可以顺手干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added taking this group to contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: our employer's ally forces are lost commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们雇主的盟友部队已失联，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACEHODLER This is Quebec actual return fire and check your rear arc!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本 这里是 Quebec 实况，还击并检查你的后方射界！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Dropped Forces Enemy Ally Primary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外空降部队·敌方盟友·主要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Dropped Forces Enemy Ally Secondary) . In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外空降部队·敌方盟友·次要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Dropped Target Forces 2 Primary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外空降目标部队 2·主要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Target Forces 2 Secondary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外目标部队 2·次要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Target Forces Primary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外目标部队·主要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Target Forces Secondary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外目标部队·次要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Hostile to All Secondary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（对所有人敌对·次要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's affirmative. Take them down as well, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认。把他们也解决掉，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's affirmative. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} rep has offered a bonus if we eliminate them, as well. Your call, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 代表提出，如果我们把他们也消灭掉会有额外奖励。你决定，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We're on station and will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's destroyed we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们已就位，将提供支援以完成主要目标。目标被摧毁后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's it Commander we did what we came here to do.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就这样，指挥官，我们来这里要做的事做完了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's unfortunate. I'll let our employers know what happened.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真不巧。我会把情况告知我们的雇主。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 已被摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary targets are down. That's a wrap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标已倒下。收工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second enemy lance was last seen here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第二支敌方小队最后出现在这里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: we're clear of the AO, thanks Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已离开作战区域，谢谢指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You're approaching the encounter area, Commander. First enemy lance is in this area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你正在接近交战区域，指挥官。第一支敌方小队就在这一带。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander! This is the Primary Objective Version.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another successful mission in the bag, Commander. Let's debrief once you're back aboard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一场成功任务入袋，指挥官。等你回到舰上我们再做简报。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} friends have deployed forces to assist in our operation here. This is the Primary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友已派出部队协助我们此处的行动。这是主要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} friends have deployed forces to assist in our operation here. This is the Secondary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友已派出部队协助我们此处的行动。这是次要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we have visuals on the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们目视到第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Copy that lance leader.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，小队长。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander. Oliviera out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。奥利维拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Got a Leopard on radar, Commander. Looks like it's making a drop; I'll mark its LZ for you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷达上有一艘"豹"级，指挥官。看来它要投放部队，我会为你标出它的着陆区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Grace under fire folks. Lay it on 'em!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 各位，火线之下也要沉住气。狠狠地打！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hark {COMMANDER.Name} here are unexpected {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} bad guys  are here too. Don't that beat it all. This is the secondary objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听好了 {COMMANDER.Name}，这里还来了意想不到的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 坏蛋。真是奇了怪了。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hark {COMMANDER.Name} here are unexpected {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} bad guys are here too. Don't that beat it all. This is the primary objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听好了 {COMMANDER.Name}，这里还来了意想不到的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 坏蛋。真是奇了怪了。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, Darius I'm seeing new heat signatures on the field. Second enemy lance is unbound?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，达里乌斯，我在战场上看到新的热信号。第二支敌方小队解除了约束？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: holy cow what a surprise its a {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance! A surprise indeed. This is the Primary Objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的天，真是惊喜，居然是一支 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！确实是惊喜。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: holy cow what a surprise its a {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance! A surprise indeed. This is the Secondary Objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的天，真是惊喜，居然是一支 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！确实是惊喜。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm inbound to the LZ, Commander. Get your people over there for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我正前往着陆区，指挥官。让你的人过去等待接运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm seeing new heat signatures on the field, Commander. Our mystery tangos, I'm guessing?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在战场上看到新的热信号，指挥官。我猜是我们的神秘目标？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ladies and Gentlemen welcome to Solaris Medium League battle! Let the fight begin!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女士们先生们，欢迎来到索拉里斯中型联赛对战！让战斗开始吧！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we have some unexpected support from {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. This is the Primary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们有来自 {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队的意外支援。这是主要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we have some unexpected support from {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. This is the Secondary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们有来自 {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队的意外支援。这是次要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on the field. This is the Primary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战场上出现更多 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on the field. This is the Secondary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战场上出现更多 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added taking this group to contract as a bonus. If we want to make some extra C-bills we can take them out if we want.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把歼灭这伙人列为合同的附加奖励。想多赚点 C 币的话，我们可以顺手干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added taking this group to contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: our employer's ally forces are lost commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们雇主的盟友部队已失联，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACEHODLER This is Quebec actual return fire and check your rear arc!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本 这里是 Quebec 实况，还击并检查你的后方射界！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Target Forces 2 Secondary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（对所有人敌对·次要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's affirmative. Take them down as well, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认。把他们也解决掉，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's affirmative. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} rep has offered a bonus if we eliminate them, as well. Your call, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 代表提出，如果我们把他们也消灭掉会有额外奖励。你决定，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We're on station and will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's destroyed we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们已就位，将提供支援以完成主要目标。目标被摧毁后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's it Commander we did what we came here to do.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就这样，指挥官，我们来这里要做的事做完了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's unfortunate. I'll let our employers know what happened.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真不巧。我会把情况告知我们的雇主。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 已被摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary targets are down. That's a wrap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标已倒下。收工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second enemy lance was last seen here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第二支敌方小队最后出现在这里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: we're clear of the AO, thanks Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已离开作战区域，谢谢指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You're approaching the encounter area, Commander. First enemy lance is in this area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你正在接近交战区域，指挥官。第一支敌方小队就在这一带。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's it Commander we did what we came here to do.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就这样，指挥官，我们来这里要做的事做完了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's unfortunate. I'll let our employers know what happened.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真不巧。我会把情况告知我们的雇主。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 已被摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary targets are down. That's a wrap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标已倒下。收工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second enemy lance was last seen here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第二支敌方小队最后出现在这里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, another match in the Medium Tank League. Good luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，中型坦克联赛的又一场比赛。祝你好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ladies and Gentlemen welcome to Solaris Medium Tank League! Let the fight begin!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女士们先生们，欢迎来到索拉里斯中型坦克联赛！让战斗开始吧！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ok, that was unfortunate. Let's prepare for the next match better.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，真不巧。下次比赛我们准备得更好些。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 1x1 Offseason Duel
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 1×1 休赛期决斗

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Solaris gladiators are known for their unusual 'Mech designs. Keep an eye out and expect the unexpected.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 索拉里斯角斗士以不寻常的机甲设计著称。留神观察，做好遇到意外的准备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got some downtime in our recording schedule. One of our gladiators couldn't show due to a maintenance accident on their 'Mech. If you're up for a quick buck, and maybe a shot at stardom, we could let you go a few rounds and see how you square up. Interested?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的录制日程有点空档。我们的一位角斗士因机甲维修事故无法出场。如果你想赚笔快钱，也许还想搏个明星梦，我们可以让你打几个回合，看看你的斤两。有兴趣吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got some downtime in our recording schedule. One of our Stables double booked and decided to bail on the match. We already have all the recording kit set up and it'd be a shame to let it go to waste. Feel up for taking a shot for the cameras?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的录制日程有些空档。有家马疚重复预订后决定放弃这场比赛。我们所有录制设备都已架好，浪费掉太可惜。有兴趣为镜头来一场吗？

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 今天没有现场观众，各位。摄影机3、2、1开机！比赛开始！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not the strangest contract we've been offered, if you can even call it that. Solaris 'Mechs aren't known for their conventional loadouts, Commander, so just keep that in mind.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这算不上我们接到过最奇怪的合约，如果它还能被称为合约的话。索拉里斯机甲并不以常规载荷闻名，指挥官，所以记住这一点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, Commander {Commander.LastName}. We just so happen to have a four-man gladiator team who are looking to cut their teeth in some new 'Mechs. Obviously, we can't bang up our own metal - we need that stuff! But you? Well, we can throw a handful of cash at you if you want to step in and help them practice.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，指挥官{Commander.LastName}。我们恰好有一支四人角斗小队想在新机甲上练练牙口。显然，我们不能把自己那身铁皮弄坏——我们还需要它！但你呢？嗯，如果你想上场帮他们练练，我们可以给你扔一把现金。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 携带旗标的机甲正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Reach the Evac Zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 抵达撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recover the VIP's assistant by securing the Secondary Designated Area
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领次要指定区域以接回要人的助手

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unit Carrying the Flag Must Survive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 携带旗标的单位必须存活

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset has been recovered, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产已回收，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] The secondary asset is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Best of luck, Commander. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the Flag location is straight ahead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，旗标位置就在正前方。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold this location until the Flag is captured.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守住此处直到旗标被夺取。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ladies and Gentlemen welcome to Solaris off-season battle! Let the fight begin!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女士们先生们，欢迎来到索拉里斯休赛期对战！让战斗开始吧！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once you have secured the Flag, you need to get to the extraction zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夺取旗标后，你需要前往撤离区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's it, mech recovering our Secondary Target is scraped. S&R will look for what's left. That objective is failed. Focus on the Primary.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 完了，回收我们次要目标的那台机甲报废了。搜救队会去找剩下能用的东西。那个目标失败了。专注主要目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Flag has been recovered, Commander. Good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旗标已夺回，指挥官。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Flag has been recovered, Commander. Now you need to bring it to the extraction point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旗标已夺回，指挥官。现在你需要把它带到撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The mech carrying the Flag is sustaining damage, Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 携带旗标的机甲正在受损，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This went south in a hurry. Better luck next time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这事很快就搞砸了。下次好运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 4x4 Free For All Battle
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4×4 自由近战

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, in this match 3 lances drop, the one that survives - wins.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，本场比赛空降三个小队，活下来的那个获胜。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All our objectives are complete, cover our withdraw Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们所有目标都已完成，掩护我们撤退，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander! This is the Primary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander! This is the Secondary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another successful mission in the bag, Commander. Let's debrief once you're back aboard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一场成功任务入袋，指挥官。等你回到舰上我们再做简报。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} friends have deployed forces to assist in our operation here. This is the Primary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友已派出部队协助我们此处的行动。这是主要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} friends have deployed forces to assist in our operation here. This is the Secondary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友已派出部队协助我们此处的行动。这是次要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we have visuals on the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们目视到第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Copy that lance leader.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，小队长。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good luck, Commander. Oliviera out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 祝你好运，指挥官。奥利维拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Got a Leopard on radar, Commander. Looks like it's making a drop; I'll mark its LZ for you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷达上有一艘"豹"级，指挥官。看来它要投放部队，我会为你标出它的着陆区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Grace under fire folks. Lay it on 'em!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 各位，火线之下也要沉住气。狠狠地打！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hark {COMMANDER.Name} here are unexpected {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} bad guys  are here too. Don't that beat it all. This is the secondary objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听好了 {COMMANDER.Name}，这里还来了意想不到的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 坏蛋。真是奇了怪了。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hark {COMMANDER.Name} here are unexpected {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} bad guys are here too. Don't that beat it all. This is the primary objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听好了 {COMMANDER.Name}，这里还来了意想不到的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 坏蛋。真是奇了怪了。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, Darius—I'm seeing new heat signatures on the field. Second enemy lance is unbound?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，达里乌斯——我在战场上看到新的热信号。第二支敌方小队解除了约束？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: holy cow what a surprise its a {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance! A surprise indeed. This is the Primary Objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的天，真是惊喜，居然是一支 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！确实是惊喜。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: holy cow what a surprise its a {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance! A surprise indeed. This is the Secondary Objective version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我的天，真是惊喜，居然是一支 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！确实是惊喜。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm inbound to the LZ, Commander. Get your people over there for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我正前往着陆区，指挥官。让你的人过去等待接运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm seeing new heat signatures on the field, Commander. Our mystery tangos, I'm guessing?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在战场上看到新的热信号，指挥官。我猜是我们的神秘目标？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ladies and Gentlemen welcome to Solaris off-season battle! Let the fight begin!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 女士们先生们，欢迎来到索拉里斯休赛期对战！让战斗开始吧！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we have some unexpected support from {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. This is the Primary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们有来自 {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队的意外支援。这是主要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we have some unexpected support from {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. This is the Secondary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们有来自 {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队的意外支援。这是次要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on the field. This is the Primary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战场上出现更多 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on the field. This is the Secondary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战场上出现更多 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added taking this group to contract as a bonus. If we want to make some extra C-bills we can take them out if we want.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把歼灭这伙人列为合同的附加奖励。想多赚点 C 币的话，我们可以顺手干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added taking this group to contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: our employer's ally forces are lost commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们雇主的盟友部队已失联，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACEHODLER This is Quebec actual return fire and check your rear arc!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本 这里是 Quebec 实况，还击并检查你的后方射界！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Dropped Forces Enemy Ally Primary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外空降部队·敌方盟友·主要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Dropped Forces Enemy Ally Secondary) . In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外空降部队·敌方盟友·次要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Dropped Target Forces 2 Primary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外空降目标部队 2·主要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Target Forces 2 Secondary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外目标部队 2·次要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Target Forces Primary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外目标部队·主要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Target Forces Secondary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（额外目标部队·次要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Hostile to All Secondary). In bound hostile Dropship detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占位文本（对所有人敌对·次要）。探测到入境敌方空投舰，投放区已标记。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's affirmative. Take them down as well, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认。把他们也解决掉，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's affirmative. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} rep has offered a bonus if we eliminate them, as well. Your call, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 代表提出，如果我们把他们也消灭掉会有额外奖励。你决定，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We're on station and will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's destroyed we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们已就位，将提供支援以完成主要目标。目标被摧毁后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's it Commander we did what we came here to do.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就这样，指挥官，我们来这里要做的事做完了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's unfortunate. I'll let our employers know what happened.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真不巧。我会把情况告知我们的雇主。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} has been destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 已被摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary targets are down. That's a wrap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标已倒下。收工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second enemy lance was last seen here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第二支敌方小队最后出现在这里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: we're clear of the AO, thanks Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已离开作战区域，谢谢指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You're approaching the encounter area, Commander. First enemy lance is in this area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你正在接近交战区域，指挥官。第一支敌方小队就在这一带。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A customised Behemoth model A of uncertain origin outfitted in rare LosTech, this tank is the property of the Solaris Tank Jockey Scott Mayur. The main guns are replaced with vintage LB-10X Auto-cannons, 4 Streak SRM-2's are mounted in place of the LRM-5's and a pair of LRM-10 racks take the place of the original SRM-6's. These changes are enabled by the new 200 rated Fusion Engine, allegedly salvaged from a downed Enforcer. Where the LosTech came from or who provided the technical assistance needed for the retrofit is unclear. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 370 50 Left 330 50 Right 330 50 Rear 325 50 Turret 370 50 Total 1725 250 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这辆来历不明的定制巨兽A型装备着稀有的失落科技，属于索拉里斯坦克车手斯科特·马尤尔。主炮被换成老式LB-10X自动炮，四具连发SRM-2取代了LRM-5，两组LRM-10挂架则取代了原来的SRM-6。这些改动得以实现，全靠新装的200额定聚变引擎——据称是从一架坠毁的执法者上拆下来的。失落科技从何而来、又是谁提供了改装所需的技术援助，至今不明。 生态限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 370 50 左侧 330 50 右侧 330 50 后方 325 50 炮塔 370 50 总计 1725 250 特性：主战坦克

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Long rumoured to be a representative of the Draconis Combine, Michika Miyazaki's latest refit of her beloved Brutus appear to confirm the rumours. A 225 rated XL Engine - allegedly sourced from a Komodo KIM-2 - and Ferro-Fibrous armour are the centrepiece of the upgrades though the most eye catching is a Clan spec targeting computer linked into the new ER Large Lasers. A pair of the Combines experimental MRM-10's replace the LRM-20 and a Beagle Active Probe rounds out the overhaul. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 190 40 Left 150 40 Right 150 40 Rear 125 40 Turret 150 40 Total 765 200 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长期有传言说宫崎美智佳是龙脉联合体的代表，而她对心爱布鲁图斯的最新改装似乎印证了这些传闻。一台225额定XL引擎——据称来自一架科莫多KIM-2——加上铁纤维装甲是升级的核心，但最抢眼的还是接驳到新增程大型激光上的部族规格瞄准计算机。一对联合体实验型MRM-10取代了LRM-20，一台比格犬主动探测器为这次大修收尾。 生态限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 护甲： 铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 190 40 左侧 150 40 右侧 150 40 后方 125 40 炮塔 150 40 总计 765 200 特性：主战坦克

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hailing from the Free Rasalhague Republic, Tyra Murchie is often characterised as an eccentric genius. Her latest ride is proof of this. Originally a standard Bulldog MBT, it has been rebuilt around a custom made Fuel Cell engine. Taking advantage of the lighter engine, a Guardian ECM unit was installed and Clan spec Large Pulse Laser replaces the original Large Laser. Where the Laser came from or how Tyra managed to adapt the supposedly incompatible IS and Clan technology remains a mystery. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 140 30 Left 120 30 Right 120 30 Rear 100 30 Turret 120 30 Total 600 150 Quirk: Main Battle Tank
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 来自自由拉沙尔哈格共和国的泰拉·默奇常被形容为古怪的天才，她最新的坐骑便是明证。它原本是一辆标准斗牛犬主战坦克，如今围绕一台定制的燃料电池引擎重建。利用更轻的引擎，车上装了一套守护者电子对抗单元，并以部族规格大型脉冲激光取代原有大型激光。那门激光从何而来，泰拉又是如何把据说互不兼容的内层星域与部族技术接合起来的，至今仍是个谜。 生态限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 护甲： 护甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 140 30 左侧 120 30 右侧 120 30 后方 100 30 炮塔 120 30 总计 600 150 特性：主战坦克

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chevalier Light Tank was produced by and for the Star League. The Succession Wars devastated the stores of the Chevalier as the Successor States often cannibalized them for parts. Only Millennium Industries of Terra continued to produce the design, and that was snapped up by ComStar. Though the top speed is only 97 km/h, it is still respectable for a wheeled vehicle. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 140 20 Left 125 20 Right 125 20 Rear 110 20 Turret 120 20 Total 620 100 Quirk: Easy to Pilot

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A relative newcomer to the Solaris scene, Izak Cranworth is a former Mercenary and amateur archaeologist who struck it lucky. Stumbling on to a cache of SLDF spare parts, Izak was able to upgrade his battered Condor. Reskinning the tank in Ferro Fibrous and swapping the ICE for a similar sized 225 Fusion Engine - both sourced from wrecked Nightshade VTOL's - allowed Izak to upgrade the AC/5 to a UAC/5. The Machine Gun is replaced by an Anti Missile System and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers replace the original Medium Lasers. A recently acquired ClanTech Targeting Computer drastically improves the accuracy of the disparate weapons array. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 170 25 Left 100 25 Right 100 25 Rear 100 25 Turret 140 25 Total 610 125 Quirk: Quick Off The Line
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伊扎克·克兰沃斯是索拉里斯赛场上的相对新面孔，这位前雇佣兵兼业余考古学家撞了大运。他偶然发现了一处SLDF备件储藏点，从而得以升级自己那辆破旧的秃鹰。给坦克重新披上铁纤维装甲，并把内燃机换成尺寸相近的225聚变引擎——两者都取自坠毁的夜影VTOL——让伊扎克能把AC/5升级为UAC/5。机枪换成一套反导弹系统，原装中型激光则由一对中型脉冲激光取代。最近到手的一台部族技术瞄准计算机大幅提升了这套杂式武器阵列的精度。 生态限制：无。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米。 护甲： 重型铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 170 25 左侧 100 25 右侧 100 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 140 25 总计 610 125 特性：启动迅速

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A familiar face on the Solaris circuits, Daovieng Li is back after an extended absence. A disastrous mishap in her last match resulted in the loss of her Ontos and Li is betting on her new Demolisher to carry her to victory. A modified copy of the standard vehicle, the Demolisher has been rebuilt around a massive ClanTech Targeting Computer; ensuring the feared 155mm ChemJets rarely miss. A custom made Fuel Cell frees up the weight needed for this and a Guardian ECM Suite. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 235 40 Left 190 40 Right 190 40 Rear 150 40 Turret 235 40 Total 1000 200 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 道文·李是索拉里斯巡回赛上的熟面孔，在长期缺席后归来。她在上一场比赛中的一次灾难性失误导致她的昂托斯损毁，李如今把取胜的希望押在新买的破坏者上。这辆破坏者是对标准车的改装版，围绕一台庞大的部族技术瞄准计算机重建，确保那令人生畏的155毫米化学喷射炮很少失手。定制的燃料电池腾出了加装它和一套守护者电子对抗套件所需的重量。 生态限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 护甲： 铁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 正面 235 40 左侧 190 40 右侧 190 40 后方 150 40 炮塔 235 40 总计 1000 200 特性：精准武器 - 自动炮

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A former LCAF Tank Driver, James Erskine came to Solaris with a mountain of debt and a mostly intact Drillson MBT. Since then he and his Tank have become a familiar presence on the amateur circuits and it won't be long before he breaks into the bigger leagues. The LTV series was the response as part of an effort to counter proliferation of BattleMech technologies stolen from the Hegemony. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 3030, Aldis Industries deployed the successful follow up to its venerable Demolisher design, the slightly lighter Zhukov. While it shares many of the parts and features of the design that inspired it, the Zhukov is smaller, better armored, and packs less weaponry than its predecessor. Its first major deployment was with the Wolf's Dragoons whereupon the Zhukov has since seen constant improvements and tweaks as suggested to Aldis Industries by the field units that use it. The Zhukov's strength is its relative simplicity. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Rommel tank is a 65-ton armored combat vehicle, specializing in close range fighting and urban combat. Identical to its twin, the Patton, in every way but armament and armor configuration, the Rommel has primarily served with the Lyran Commonwealth and the Lyran Alliance. It is named after Field Marshal Erwin Rommel, a legendary commander of armored and mechanized forces renowned for his exploits during World War II on Terra. The Rommel was designed concurrently with the Patton in the early 3000s, when Defiance Industries decided that an armored combat vehicle capable of replacing 'Mechs was needed. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 3030, Aldis Industries deployed the successful follow up to its venerable Demolisher design, the slightly lighter Zhukov. While it shares many of the parts and features of the design that inspired it, the Zhukov is smaller, better armored, and packs less weaponry than its predecessor. Its first major deployment was with the Wolf's Dragoons whereupon the Zhukov has since seen constant improvements and tweaks as suggested to Aldis Industries by the field units that use it. The Zhukov's strength is its relative simplicity. Two turret mounted SarLon MaxiCannon Autocannon/10s are more than adequate at providing sufficient firepower for the discriminating buyer while imitating its larger cousin the Demolisher.
